thread:
alex: Opening PR that standardizes invoke examples to use the new sdk.parseResponse helper. Files changed: docs/guides/invoke.md, examples/structured-output/*.md. Will run link-checker. Need reviewers @marta @samir :eyes:

marta: Thanks — I can review today. Quick Q: do we include both a full JSON Schema example and the compact-envelope pattern?

samir: prefer both. can we add a tiny shim for nullable arrays? saw prod hit error when model returned null vs [] and our parser choked.

lia: docs-bot: link-checker failure — 2 anchors in examples/structured-output/array-guides.md -> 404. See output: `Missing anchor: #array-canonicalization`

alex: Pushed an update, example snippet below — uses sdk.parseResponse to validate and fallback:

```js
const schema = { type: 'object', properties: { items: { type: ['array','null'], items: { type: 'string' } } }, required: ['items'] };
const resp = await client.invoke({ prompt: 'list items' });
const parsed = await sdk.parseResponse(resp, { schema, fallback: { items: [] } });
```

marta: LGTM, but add one-line Node SDK example showing `await sdk.parseResponse(resp, { schema })` in the codeblock so readers can copy-paste. Also add a note about `fallback` semantics.

alex: Added tests at examples/test/parse.spec.js and fixed one anchor. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — left TODO to expand edge cases.

samir: I'll follow up with a tiny PR to patch the remaining anchors and the long-line linter issue in schema examples.

marta: Don't forget to add a changelog entry in /docs/CHANGELOG.md — one-liner about "invoke examples: use sdk.parseResponse; added nullable-array guidance".

alex: Sounds good. Plan to merge tomorrow after one more review. @docs-bot please re-run :pr-check :shipit:
